message: Astra: Within Ya na’s scene, what does Alex’s latest reply give the reader grounds to believe, rather than merely promise? Which words deserve closer attention when judging his credibility? Why would more thinking be worth its time compared with trying a revision now, and what unresolved uncertainty could make waiting preferable? What textual evidence would justify either choice? Can you briefly state your finding, uncertainty, and chosen next intention in English, then carry it out?
